name: humanlens
description: Human Lens — AI-assisted qualitative-synthesis tool (Module 1: the Listening Brief).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @humanlens/shared && npm run build --workspace @humanlens/backend && npm run build --workspace @humanlens/frontend
scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,9000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force }"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
